title: [r9] Prohibit version/generation markers in artifact names; hidden-timestamp lineage only (A627)
summary: Governor-directed addition: no file name, folder name, module name or artifact identifier may carry a version or generation marker. Recency is distinguished solely by hidden timestamp lineage; the only exemption is package/dependency/toolchain version declarations.
origin: human-governor directive 2026-09-26: except package versions, no version/generation markers in names (files, folders, modules); uniform hidden timestamps; recency decided by timestamp order alone

problem.summary: Artifact naming drifts toward ordinal version decorations (e.g. -rN resubmit suffixes, _vN, _old/_new pairs, generation labels) which duplicate state, desynchronize from governed timestamp lineage (A200/A389/A487 already make timestamps the authoritative recency model) and force consumers to rebind on every revision. No provision currently forbids version/generation markers on name surfaces.

rows.subject: artifact-name-version-marker-prohibition
rows.rule: NAME-SURFACE-VERSION-MARKER-PROHIBITION:no file name,folder name,module name or artifact identifier may carry a version or generation qualifier(ordinal decorations such as vN,verN,genN,-rN revision suffixes,era or generation labels,and _old/_new/_final/_latest/_draft/_copy/_bak style markers)and no name surface may encode a change class as identity. RECENCY-MECHANISM:the sole discriminator between revisions of one artifact is its hidden timestamp lineage(governed metadata timestamps per A200/A391 and timestamp-suffixed artifact names per established convention);recency resolves by timestamp ordering alone and the stable name surface never changes across revisions so consumers never rebind. ORDERING:where a loader or pipeline requires sequence, order derives from timestamp order or a governed registry cursor,never from name-encoded ordinals. VERSION-DATA:typed version identities remain valid as registry data under A395/A487(codex timestamp versions, schema/ABI identities,and package/dependency versions) but are never expressed in artifact names. RESUBMISSION AND ITERATION:succeeded or superseded artifacts are distinguished by a fresh timestamp identity,not an ordinal revision suffix. MIGRATION:existing marker-carrying names are corrected by timestamped rename under a governed compatibility mapping(A222 rename law);new violations are flagged fail-closed by audit scans.
rows.prohibition: FORBID:version/generation qualifier in any file/folder/module/artifact name|ordinal revision suffix(-rN,_vN,genN,revN) in new or renamed artifacts|_old/_new/_final/_latest/_copy/_bak name decoration|consumer ordering by name-encoded ordinals|version value embedded in an identity surface
rows.exception: package,dependency and toolchain version declarations in manifests,lockfiles,pin tables and the A615 version table keep literal version syntax;structural ordering indices required by a loader(migration sequence,mirror part index,provision position)are ordering cursors, not version markers;historical marker-carrying names remain immutable evidence until renamed under a governed compatibility mapping;third-party/upstream artifact names are not renamed

verification.expected_audit_result: A627 inserted at position 627 as the sole name-surface version-marker prohibition; ordering preserved; projections rebuilt for successor generation
